 San Francisco 49ers San Francisco 49ers left tackle Trent Williams highlights the advantages of having an experienced, veteran-heavy roster.
--> San Francisco 49ers left tackle Trent Williams highlights the advantages of having an experienced, veteran-heavy roster.
 Williams is one of the oldest players on the team, but many of the stars synonymous with San Francisco’s success over the past few years are either approaching 30 or already past that age range.
--> Williams is one of the oldest players on the team, but many of the stars synonymous with San Francisco’s success over the past few years are either approaching 30 or already past that age range.
 As a result, the 49ers have one of the oldest rosters in the league , something Williams believes can provide an intriguing recruitment model for younger players to learn from and follow.

 "All our young, super talented guys that we have, pretty much every position room has a north star, somebody that they can look to and actually follow and literally learn how to do it the way we do it," Williams said on the TK Show podcast .

 "I think it's a beautiful structure to the locker room, having a guy like [newest wide receiver addition] Keenan [Allen], just a guy that knows how to win.

He is currently the owner of a motorbike racing outlet titled The Moto Report, where he produces written and video content on the biggest motorbike racing series in the world. Henry has previously contributed San Francisco 49ers content to VAVEL USA, The League Winners, and OffGrid NFL. Based in the UK, Henry began following the organization in the 2011 season, before attending his first game in October 2022. His career highlights include covering the team for On SI throughout 2025 and previously interviewing 49ers legend George Kittle on a wide range of topics, such as his career highlights and what it means to him to represent the city of San Francisco.
